title: DSWD releases P410.3M to RSSI-hit sugarcane farmers in Negros

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY — The Department of Social Welfare and Development-Negros Island Region (DSWD-NIR) has distributed P410.28 million in Emergency Cash Transfers (ECT) to 39,847 sugarcane farmers affected by red-striped soft scale insects (RSSI), Regional Director Arwin Razo said Sunday. Razo said more payouts would continue through the end of the year as the agency awaits additional funds. Total assistance could exceed P1 billion, he said. The RSSI damages sugarcane by sucking sap from the stalks and leaves.
